# Cantrip

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Spells and Magic](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Cantrip)*

A cantrip is a level 0 spell, which is cast without a spell slot. *See also* "[Spells](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/spells/)".
